source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Μαΐου — «Όσιοι Μιχαήλ και Αρσένιος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its whole body is two sentences: «Οι Όσιοι Μιχαήλ και Αρσένιος κατάγονταν από τη Γεωργία και έζησαν τον 9ο αιώνα μ.Χ. Ασκήτεψαν σε μονή του όρους Όλυμπος της Βιθυνίας της Μικράς Ασίας.» **The page names two men and so it is two folders**, each with a head line of its own and each carrying a `related` row to the other on the strength of that one sentence. **The display name keeps the companionship clause**, as the corpus keeps about sixty such, because a bare Michael would not be told from the eleven the corpus already holds — of Kyiv, of Chernigov, of Klops, Maleinos and the rest — nor from the `michael-the-wonderworker` of 1 Μαΐου drafted two days before this one, who is likewise almost unplaced. What separates the two is that this Michael has an origin, a century and a mountain, and that one has a Paris codex and nothing else. No year, no hymn, no relic.
